item.title: 10 New Movies to Watch This Weekend on Netflix, Prime Video, and Hulu (November 27-29)
item.description: Happy Thanksgiving! As expected, it’s a big one for movies . Disney’s latest, Hexed , is out in theaters. There’s also Focker-In-Law , the newest addition to the Meet the Parents franchise. The most intriguing film this weekend, though, is The Further Misadventures of Cliff Booth , which finds Quentin Tarantino continuing the story of Brad Pitt’s character from Once Upon a Time… in Hollywood through David Fincher’s lens. It at least has to be an interesting experiment in different cinematic styles.

item.title: 8 New TV Shows to Watch This Weekend on Netflix and Prime Video (November 27-29)
item.description: Happy Thanksgiving! There’s a lot of TV to watch this weekend, whether you’re tuning in to shows that are already airing or looking for your next binge .

item.title: Magic: The Gathering Designer Reveals 2026’s 11 Best New Commanders
item.description: With 2026 delivering a packed release schedule for Magic: The Gathering exploring classic planes and several Universes Beyond crossovers, Commander players have had plenty of exciting new legends to build around. From returning to familiar fantasy worlds in sets like Lorwyn Eclipsed and Secrets of Strixhaven to epic crossovers like Marvel Super Heroes , The Hobbit , and Star Trek , the year brought an unprecedented wave of Commanders for casual and competitive tables alike.

item.title: Dune Director Admits He’s ‘Deeply Disappointed’ by Showdown With Avengers: Doomsday
item.description: Denis Villeneuve isn't thrilled about having to share a release date with Marvel's next Avengers movie. The Dune: Part Three director has admitted he's "deeply disappointed" after Disney scheduled Avengers: Doomsday for the same December release date as his upcoming sci-fi sequel. In an interview with Time , Villeneuve discussed the unusual box-office showdown between the two highly anticipated films, both of which are scheduled to open Dec. 18.

item.title: New Dungeon Crawler Carl Release Officially Set for 2027
item.description: Even if you haven't read any of the books , you've probably heard of Dungeon Crawler Carl at this point. The LitRPG book series (a genre defined by its use of video game and tabletop RPG mechanics) by Matt Dinniman has become a cultural juggernaut, and it is only getting bigger. In addition to a television adaptation , Dungeon Crawler Carl is also getting another new adaptation in 2027.

item.title: Steve Rogers Steals Another Thor Power in Official New Official Avengers: Doomsday Trailer
item.description: Avengers: Doomsday trailers have played up Thor's simmering jealousy over Steve Rogers wielding an intact Mjölnir , Thor's enchanted hammer. Steve has summoned lightning with it, like in Avengers: Endgame , and a new TV spot for Doomsday shows him utilizing another of Thor's powers.

item.title: Brainwashing Easter egg walkthrough in GTA 6
item.description: The brainwashing Easter egg in Grand Theft Auto 6 is a long side mission in which you get the chance to investigate long-forgotten bunkers where a certain president spent some time (and listened to rumba) and where brainwashing experiments had taken place. Like the Vice City portal Easter egg , you'll need to go through a series of steps to finish this mission, but there's no other option if you want to learn the truth about what the government hid from you.

item.title: Black Friday 2026's 10 Best Magic: The Gathering Deals
item.description: Black Friday is here, and if you’ve been waiting to pick up a new Magic: The Gathering Commander deck, this is a good weekend to do it. Best Buy has the Fantastic Four deck for under $40, and Amazon has deals on precons from Final Fantasy and Star Trek .

item.title: GTA 6 Officially Passes a Massive Sales Milestone Just 1 Week In
item.description: We might have to stop saying something sold like hotcakes and start saying something sold like Grand Theft Auto 6 . Rockstar's latest has sold about as well as we expected, with estimates after only one week putting sales at over 50 million copies . That number will only go up in the weeks and months to come, especially if a new GTA Online mode and a PC version are eventually announced, as rumored .

item.title: GTA 6 Players Are Not, In Fact, Eating Good
item.description: There are countless ways to spend your time in Grand Theft Auto 6 . You can scoop up pricey bundles of cocaine in a seaplane, do deadlifts to get sick gains, and scuba dive to discover marine life and lost pirate treasure. You can steal an elderly woman's mobility scooter and go to a yard sale to find cool vintage T-shirts . But sadly, one thing you cannot do is savor a delicious meal, whether it's on a solo outing or even on a date night with Jason and Lucia. GTA 6 has a vast, deep world with astonishing attention to detail in almost every capacity. But there's one area where the game comes up surprisingly short — the food.
